parole.significato: level or storey of a structure

From earlier دریوش (daryōš), from درغوش (darġōš), from Middle Persian dlgwš (/⁠driyōš⁠/), in turn, Old Iranian *drigu-, from a Proto-Indo-Iranian root shared with Sanskrit ध्रिगु (dhrigu, “needy”) and Avestan 𐬛𐬭𐬌𐬔𐬎 (drigu), 𐬛𐬭𐬌𐬖𐬎 (driγu, “poor, needy”).
Inherited from Middle Persian pʿk (/⁠-bāg⁠/), from Old Iranian *pāka-, from the root pak- (“to cook”). Compare Sanskrit पचति (pacati, “to cook, bake”).
